id: title:Gilbert09:add data observability tools as self driving inbox sources

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Monte Carlo and Bigeye as supported external incident signal sources, allowing PostHog to ingest and display alerts from these services.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates the registration and configuration of Monte Carlo and Bigeye as new external data sources. P1.F4.H3 adds the registration calls, and P1.F5.H1 adds them to the tier 1 test registry. This establishes the capability and supported status for these specific vendors. No backend implementation or database migration is present, so the tier is conservative.
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the backend implementation, database migration, and complete frontend integration, meaning the actual behavior and reliability of the ingestion are not demonstrated. The score relies solely on the configuration and registration, not the working implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the backend implementation of the Monte Carlo and Bigeye signal ingestion, the database migration, or the complete frontend integration. It only shows the addition of the configuration and the registration of the new signal sources. While this is a necessary prerequisite, the complete implementation and its behavior are not demonstrated. This chunk alone
